entities.name: Patrick Daniel Norton
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Patrick Daniel Norton was an American politician who served as a member of the United States House of Representatives from 1913 to 1919, representing North Dakota's 3rd congressional district as a member of the Republican Party.
